## What's new in Igggy 0.1.18
- **Your voice is kept from the first word with AirPods.** When a recording started with AirPods or another Bluetooth headset as the microphone, the first few seconds of your voice could go missing. Igggy now waits the moment it takes the headset to switch over before it starts recording, and tells you plainly if no sound arrives. - **Connecting Google Calendar takes you to Today.** After you sign in, Settings closes, a short "Google Calendar connected" message appears, and your meetings are right there. - **Back to today in one click.** If you've paged ahead to another day, clicking Today in the sidebar brings the meeting list back to today. - **The next meeting lifts when you point at it.** In Today and the menu bar, the next meeting's card now rises slightly on hover instead of turning gray. - **See who's coming at a glance.** A meeting shows its attendees as small circles of initials, with the organizer first. Before the meeting, a solid circle has said yes and a hollow one hasn't said yes yet. Click a circle for the name and email, or the "people" count for everyone, grouped by their reply.
